title: News: Entra memberOf operator stops on 3 November
blurb: Dynamic groups, AUs and access package auto-assignment using memberOf freeze from 3 Nov 2026; how to find and replace them.
text: News: the preview memberOf operator in Entra dynamic membership rules is retired worldwide on 3 November 2026 (MC1529463). Groups, dynamic administrative units and entitlement management auto-assignment policies that use it stop updating and keep their last membership. Graph PowerShell to find them, replacement options, and the Entra ID Governance extension to 31 March 2027 (MC1488839).

title: News: Intune enforces Android strong integrity
blurb: Android 13+ devices need hardware attestation and a patch from the last 12 months since 31 Oct 2026.
text: News: since 31 October 2026 Intune enforces Google's updated Play strong integrity verdict on Android 13 and later (MC1287362). Devices without a security patch from the last 12 months fall to device integrity and can be blocked by app protection or marked noncompliant. How to find them and warn users first.

title: News: Teams help desk impersonation to AD CS ESC1/ESC8
blurb: Microsoft's 30 Oct write-up: Quick Assist, portable runtimes, ESC1 template abuse, PetitPotam relay to Web Enrollment.
text: News: Microsoft Threat Intelligence described two intrusions that began with fake IT support on Teams and Quick Assist and ended in AD CS abuse (ESC1 certificates for privileged accounts plus DCSync; PetitPotam relayed to Web Enrollment for a DC certificate and PKINIT). What to fix, with links to our AD CS Tier 0 guide.

title: News: NTLMv1-derived SSO blocked by default
blurb: October 2026 updates enforce BlockNtlmv1SSO where Credential Guard is off; PEAP-MSCHAPv2 Wi-Fi and VPN can fail.
text: News: from the 13 October 2026 security update, Windows 11 24H2 and later and Windows Server 2025 default BlockNtlmv1SSO to Enforce when the value is not set (KB5066470). MS-CHAPv2-based Wi-Fi, wired and VPN single sign-on can stop working. Event IDs 4024/4025, the temporary registry exception and the EAP-TLS fix.

title: News: Windows and Edge distrust eMudhra CAs
blurb: Eight exposed eMudhra intermediate keys blocked on 20 Oct; six G3 roots and a cross-sign removed 26–27 Oct.
text: News: Microsoft blocked eight compromised eMudhra intermediate CA keys in the Windows Disallowed CTL and the Edge/WebView2 CRLSet on 20 October 2026, then removed six eMudhra G3 roots and an AAA Certificate Services cross-sign from the Windows (26 Oct) and Edge (27 Oct) trust lists. What to check for dependent certificates and disconnected devices.

title: News: CallActivityEvents for Teams calls in Defender XDR

text: News: Defender XDR advanced hunting gets a CallActivityEvents table for Teams calls and meetings (MC1532241), joinable with MessageEvents on ThreadId, also via the streaming API and Sentinel. Rolling out early to mid November 2026 for Defender for Office 365 Plan 2.

text: Updated news: Choose Your Own Telephony provider (CYOT) for Entra SMS and voice became generally available on 30 October 2026 (MC1519855), bought through Microsoft Security Store. Added purchasing prerequisites, SSPR scope and the internal guest date (1 February 2027).

title: New tool: Conditional Access policy generator
blurb: Pick a scenario, get Graph JSON and New-MgIdentityConditionalAccessPolicy PowerShell. Report-only by default, break-glass excluded, runs in your browser.
text: New interactive Conditional Access policy generator in the Code Library. Nine scenarios (MFA for all users, block legacy authentication, require a compliant device, phishing-resistant MFA for admin roles, sign-in risk MFA or block, high user risk with password change, block device code flow, protect security info registration). Options for pilot group, break-glass group exclusion, Directory Synchronization Accounts exclusion, authentication strength and policy state. Output is Microsoft Graph v1.0 JSON and Microsoft Graph PowerShell, checked against the conditionalAccessPolicy schema; the state defaults to report-only. Everything runs in your browser and nothing is sent anywhere.

title: New tool: mail DNS checker
blurb: Graded check of MX, SPF (lookup count), DMARC, Microsoft 365 DKIM, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, CAA and DNSSEC, with links to Microsoft Learn. Nothing is stored.
text: New mail DNS checker under Tools. Type a domain and your browser queries public DNS-over-HTTPS resolvers (Cloudflare, with Google as fallback) directly: MX, SPF including the 10-lookup limit and -all/~all, DMARC policy, pct, rua and alignment, the Microsoft 365 DKIM selector1/selector2 CNAMEs, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, CAA and DNSSEC. The result is an A–F grade with concrete fixes and links to Microsoft Learn and the RFCs. Tenant Recipes stores nothing and the domain is not put in the URL.

KQL: legacy authentication sign-ins, Conditional Access report-only impact, break-glass account sign-in alert, device code flow audit, and ZAP post-delivery actions. Each one is syntax-checked and links to its guide or recipe and the official reference.

title: New pillar guide: harden AD CS as Tier 0

text: New pillar guide: Harden Active Directory Certificate Services as Tier 0. Nine phases and 32 steps: inventory and assessment with Locksmith, Certipy and Defender for Identity; fixing vulnerable templates (ESC1–ESC4, ESC9, ESC13, ESC15) and CA settings (ESC6, ESC7, ESC11, ESC16); stopping NTLM relay to Web Enrollment (ESC8, KB5005413); strong certificate mapping on domain controllers (KB5014754, ESC10, ESC14); Tier 0 operation and CA backup; Certification Services auditing and AD CS detections; troubleshooting, incident response and rollback. Prompted by Microsoft's 30 October 2026 write-up of ESC1 and ESC8 intrusions.

title: Eight new exploited vulnerabilities
blurb: From the CISA KEV catalog: Ivanti, GitLab, PAN-OS, BeyondTrust and more.
text: Security: eight new exploited vulnerabilities from the CISA KEV catalog: the Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day chain (CVE-2026-104935, CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527), GitLab CI/CD regex RCE (CVE-2026-97229), the Brotli decoder flaw in Node.js and other products (CVE-2026-111497), PAN-OS management RCE (CVE-2026-0322), BeyondTrust Remote Support (CVE-2026-102764), VeloCloud Orchestrator (CVE-2026-114625), Collabora CODE for Nextcloud (CVE-2026-110447) and Adobe Commerce (CVE-2026-48356).

title: New pillar guide: internal purple team, network to hybrid identity
blurb: One authorized attack path end to end: Responder, NetExec, Hashcat, BloodHound CE, ROADtools and AADInternals, then detection and remediation of the on-prem-to-cloud seam.
text: New pillar guide: Internal purple team, from quiet network listening to compromised hybrid identity. Nine phases and 25 steps that follow a single authorized path from on-premises name-resolution poisoning to a fully enumerated Entra tenant: authorization, SOC notification and a contained lab; quiet LLMNR/NBT-NS/mDNS capture of NetNTLMv2 with Responder (analyze-first); credential validation and lateral reconnaissance with NetExec; offline cracking with Hashcat (mode 5600, lab or authorized material only); attack-path mapping with BloodHound CE including hybrid edges (SharpHound + AzureHound); cloud directory enumeration with ROADtools; deep, read-first hybrid checks with AADInternals (PHS/PTA/federation, Seamless SSO, sync); detection validation across Defender for Identity, Windows events (4624/4625/4776) and Entra sign-in/audit logs; and remediation (disable LLMNR/NBT-NS/mDNS, require SMB signing, NTLM auditing, Windows LAPS and tiering, Conditional Access and PIM fixes, retest and wipe). Defensive use only, on your own systems or with written authorization. The on-premises-rooted counterpart to the cloud-hardening-adversary-emulation guide.

title: Updated: Replace VPN with Entra Private Access
blurb: Combined Global Secure Access offering and M365 E7 in licensing; custom profiles marked preview; Home Network Support; Universal CAE signals; session affinity; Health and Alerts.
text: Updated pillar guide: Replace VPN with Microsoft Entra Private Access. Licensing now covers the combined Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access offering (available from 2 November 2026) and Microsoft 365 E7 via Entra Suite, with Entra ID P1/P2 still the prerequisite. Custom Private Access traffic forwarding profiles are marked preview, Home Network Support (preview) is added for home-subnet overlaps, the Universal CAE device and risk signals are described, connector Session Affinity is named with its Graph-only configuration, and Global Secure Access alerts and Health and Alerts (preview) join the monitoring phase. Re-verified 3 November 2026.

title: News: Private Access and Internet Access in one Global Secure Access offering
blurb: A buying change from 2 November 2026, not a product change; Entra Suite and Microsoft 365 E7 already include it.
text: New news item: from 2 November 2026 Microsoft Entra Private Access and Internet Access can be purchased together as one Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access offering. Both stay available separately; Entra Suite includes the offering and Microsoft 365 E7 includes Entra Suite.
